text:
morgan: Hey team — main CI went red right after yesterday's constraints/lockfile regen. Failing a small cluster of tests that all hit the caching layer. Repro locally in our ubuntu test image. Error snippet below.

morgan: ```
E   TypeError: get_cache() got an unexpected keyword argument 'ttl'
```

tyler: Ugh. Any idea which dep changed? Could be a transitive bump. :eyes:

morgan: I can repro with `docker run --rm -it python:3.10-buster bash -c \"pip install -r constraints.txt && pytest tests/search/test_cache.py::test_prefix_hit -q\"` — same failure.

priya: I can run a lockfile bisect now. Which test did you run?

morgan: `tests/search/test_cache.py::test_prefix_hit` is enough to trigger it.

ci-bot: rerun triggered for job `unit/linux/py310` (#4321)

priya: running `git bisect` with our bisect helper... will post result.

priya: bisect complete — culprit commit `d4c3f2a` (lockfile update) that bumped `cachetools` from `4.2.2` -> `5.0.0` in the constraints file.

sam: ok if 5.0 changes the API we should pin to 4.x immediately to get CI green. We can follow up with a code change to support 5.x.

morgan: good plan. I'll open a small PR that pins `cachetools==4.2.2` in `constraints.txt` and add a note in the changelog. @tyler can you review? :pray:

tyler: yep I'll review in ~30m. Also filing an issue to track migrating to 5.x and listing the incompatible calls.

priya: for anyone who wants to rerun the bisect locally, I used: `./scripts/lockfile-bisect.sh --test \"pytest tests/search/test_cache.py::test_prefix_hit -q\"` — speeds it up a lot.

morgan: thanks priya. I'll wait for tyler and then merge the pin. Leaving the rerun to watch CI.

infra-bot: pipeline queued for branch `pin/cachetools-4-2-2` (job set: unit, integration)

morgan: :thumbsup: Thanks all — will update when merged.
